args: ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}}"; if [ -z "$ROOT" ]; then ROOT="$(ls -dt "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"/plugins/cache/*/meta-knowledge-graph/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)"; fi; if [ ! -f "$ROOT/pyproject.toml" ]; then echo "[mkg mcp] Codex plugin root not found" >&2; exit 1; fi; LAUNCHER="$ROOT/scripts/mcp-launcher.sh"; [ -f "$LAUNCHER" ] || LAUNCHER="$ROOT/plugin/scripts/mcp-launcher.sh"; exec bash "$LAUNCHER" "$ROOT"
